articles.title: Nagaland commemorates Capt Kenguruse’s martyrdom, defence ministry urges youth to draw inspiration
articles.summary: Nagaland recently commemorated the martyrdom of Captain Kenguruse, a brave officer who made the ultimate sacrifice for the nation. The Defence Ministry utilized this occasion to encourage Indian youth, especially aspiring service personnel, to draw inspiration from Captain Kenguruse's valour, dedication, and patriotism. His legacy serves as a powerful example of courage and commitment to duty, motivating future generations towards national service.

articles.title: INS Sudarshini arrives in US, to take part in 250th anniversary celebrations
articles.summary: Indian Navy's Sail Training Ship, INS Sudarshini, has arrived at a US port on a transoceanic expedition. The ship will participate in the United States' 250th anniversary celebrations, signifying strong bilateral defence ties and naval diplomacy. This engagement provides valuable international exposure for Indian Navy personnel, reinforcing India's global maritime presence and cooperation with key allies.
